lines.ga: Dia duit.
lines.en: Hello.

lines.ga: Dia is Muire duit.
lines.en: Hello to you too.

lines.ga: Is mise Siobhán. Cad is ainm duit?
lines.en: I'm Siobhán. What's your name?

lines.ga: Pól is ainm dom.
lines.en: My name is Pól.

lines.ga: Cárb as duit, a Phóil?
lines.en: Where are you from, Pól?

lines.ga: Is as Corcaigh mé. Agus tú féin?
lines.en: I'm from Cork. And yourself?

lines.ga: Is as Gaillimh mé. Tá áthas orm bualadh leat.
lines.en: I'm from Galway. Nice to meet you.

lines.ga: Tá áthas orm bualadh leatsa freisin.
lines.en: Nice to meet you too.

lines.ga: Dia duit. Cad ba mhaith leat?
lines.en: Hello. What would you like?

lines.ga: Ba mhaith liom cupán caife, le do thoil.
lines.en: I'd like a cup of coffee, please.

lines.ga: Ar mhaith leat bainne leis?
lines.en: Would you like milk with it?

lines.ga: Ba mhaith, beagán bainne.
lines.en: Yes, a little milk.

lines.ga: Aon rud eile?
lines.en: Anything else?

lines.ga: Ba mhaith liom píosa cáca freisin.
lines.en: I'd like a piece of cake too.

lines.ga: Sin cúig euro, le do thoil.
lines.en: That's five euro, please.

lines.ga: Seo duit. Go raibh maith agat.
lines.en: Here you are. Thank you.

lines.ga: Dia duit. An féidir liom cabhrú leat?
lines.en: Hello. Can I help you?

lines.ga: Is féidir. An bhfuil arán agaibh?
lines.en: Yes. Do you have bread?

lines.ga: Tá. Tá sé ansin in aice leis an doras.
lines.en: Yes. It's over there beside the door.

lines.ga: Go hiontach. Cé mhéad atá air?
lines.en: Great. How much is it?

lines.ga: Dhá euro.
lines.en: Two euro.

lines.ga: Agus an bhfuil bainne agaibh freisin?
lines.en: And do you have milk too?

lines.ga: Níl, faraor. Tá sé ar fad díolta.
lines.en: No, I'm afraid. It's all sold out.

lines.ga: Ceart go leor. Tógfaidh mé an t-arán, mar sin.
lines.en: Okay. I'll take the bread, then.

lines.ga: Gabh mo leithscéal. Cá bhfuil an stáisiún traenach?
lines.en: Excuse me. Where is the train station?

lines.ga: Téigh díreach ar aghaidh, agus ansin cas ar chlé.
lines.en: Go straight ahead, and then turn left.

lines.ga: An bhfuil sé i bhfad ó seo?
lines.en: Is it far from here?

lines.ga: Níl. Cúig nóiméad ar shiúl na gcos.
lines.en: No. Five minutes on foot.

lines.ga: An bhfuil sé in aice leis an mbanc?
lines.en: Is it beside the bank?

lines.ga: Tá. Tá sé díreach os comhair an bhainc.
lines.en: Yes. It's right across from the bank.

lines.ga: Go raibh míle maith agat.
lines.en: Thanks a million.

lines.ga: Fáilte romhat.
lines.en: You're welcome.

lines.ga: Nach breá an lá é!
lines.en: Isn't it a fine day!

lines.ga: Is breá. Tá an ghrian ag taitneamh ar deireadh.
lines.en: It is. The sun is shining at last.

lines.ga: Bhí sé ag cur báistí ar feadh na seachtaine.
lines.en: It was raining all week.

lines.ga: Bhí. Bhí sé fuar agus fliuch freisin.
lines.en: It was. It was cold and wet too.

lines.ga: An gceapann tú go mbeidh sé go deas amárach?
lines.en: Do you think it will be nice tomorrow?

lines.ga: Ní cheapaim. Deir siad go mbeidh sé gaofar.
lines.en: I don't think so. They say it will be windy.

lines.ga: Bainimis sult as an ngrian inniu, mar sin.
lines.en: Let's enjoy the sun today, then.

lines.ga: Cinnte. Slán go fóill!
lines.en: Definitely. Bye for now!

en: At the Gaeltacht college on the first day

lines.ga: Fáilte go dtí an coláiste! Cén t-ainm atá ort?
lines.en: Welcome to the college! What's your name?

lines.ga: Aoife atá orm.
lines.en: My name is Aoife.

lines.ga: An é seo an chéad uair agat sa Ghaeltacht?
lines.en: Is this your first time in the Gaeltacht?

lines.ga: Is é. Tá beagán imní orm.
lines.en: It is. I'm a little nervous.

lines.ga: Ná bí buartha. Beidh an-chraic againn.
lines.en: Don't worry. We'll have great fun.

lines.ga: Cén t-am a thosaíonn na ranganna?
lines.en: What time do the classes start?

lines.ga: Ag a naoi gach maidin. Agus céilí gach oíche!
lines.en: At nine every morning. And a céilí every night!

lines.ga: Go hiontach! Ní raibh mé riamh ag céilí.
lines.en: Great! I've never been to a céilí.

lines.ga: Beidh tú ag damhsa anocht, mar sin.
lines.en: You'll be dancing tonight, then.

lines.ga: An bhfuil deartháireacha nó deirfiúracha agat?
lines.en: Do you have brothers or sisters?

lines.ga: Tá. Tá deartháir amháin agus deirfiúr amháin agam.
lines.en: Yes. I have one brother and one sister.

lines.ga: An bhfuil siad níos sine ná tú?
lines.en: Are they older than you?

lines.ga: Tá mo dheartháir níos sine, ach tá mo dheirfiúr níos óige.
lines.en: My brother is older, but my sister is younger.

lines.ga: Cá bhfuil cónaí orthu anois?
lines.en: Where do they live now?

lines.ga: Tá cónaí ar mo dheartháir i mBaile Átha Cliath.
lines.en: My brother lives in Dublin.

lines.ga: Agus do thuismitheoirí?
lines.en: And your parents?

lines.ga: Tá siad fós sa bhaile i gCiarraí.
lines.en: They're still at home in Kerry.

lines.ga: Is breá liom Ciarraí. Tá sé go hálainn.
lines.en: I love Kerry. It's beautiful.

lines.ga: An bhfuil tú saor ag an deireadh seachtaine?
lines.en: Are you free at the weekend?

lines.ga: Tá, Dé Sathairn. Cén fáth?
lines.en: Yes, on Saturday. Why?

lines.ga: Tá mé ag dul go dtí an trá. Ar mhaith leat teacht?
lines.en: I'm going to the beach. Would you like to come?

lines.ga: Ba mhaith, cinnte. Conas a rachaimid ann?
lines.en: Yes, definitely. How will we get there?

lines.ga: Rachaimid ar an mbus ag a deich.
lines.en: We'll go on the bus at ten.

lines.ga: An dtiocfaidh Niamh linn freisin?
lines.en: Will Niamh come with us too?

lines.ga: Ní thiocfaidh. Beidh sí ag obair.
lines.en: No. She'll be working.

lines.ga: Is trua sin. Buailfidh mé leat ag stad an bhus.
lines.en: That's a pity. I'll meet you at the bus stop.

lines.ga: Ar fheabhas. Feicfidh mé Dé Sathairn thú.
lines.en: Great. See you on Saturday.

lines.ga: Suigh síos. Cad atá cearr leat?
lines.en: Sit down. What's wrong with you?

lines.ga: Tá tinneas cinn orm agus tá scornach thinn agam.
lines.en: I have a headache and a sore throat.

lines.ga: Cá fhad atá tú mar seo?
lines.en: How long have you been like this?

lines.ga: Le trí lá anois.
lines.en: For three days now.

lines.ga: An bhfuil fiabhras ort?
lines.en: Do you have a temperature?

lines.ga: Níl, ach tá mé an-tuirseach.
lines.en: No, but I'm very tired.

lines.ga: Tá slaghdán ort. Fan sa leaba ar feadh cúpla lá.
lines.en: You have a cold. Stay in bed for a couple of days.

lines.ga: An gcaithfidh mé cógas a ghlacadh?
lines.en: Do I have to take medicine?

lines.ga: Ní chaithfidh. Ól neart uisce agus beidh tú go breá.
lines.en: No. Drink plenty of water and you'll be fine.

lines.ga: Haló?
lines.en: Hello?

lines.ga: Haló, is mise Ciarán. An bhfuil Máire ansin, le do thoil?
lines.en: Hello, it's Ciarán. Is Máire there, please?

lines.ga: Níl, faraor. Tá sí amuigh faoi láthair.
lines.en: No, I'm afraid. She's out at the moment.

lines.ga: An mbeidh sí ar ais go luath?
lines.en: Will she be back soon?

lines.ga: Beidh, timpeall a sé a chlog, is dóigh liom.
lines.en: She will, around six o'clock, I think.

lines.ga: An bhféadfá a rá léi glaoch orm?
lines.en: Could you tell her to call me?

lines.ga: Cinnte. An bhfuil d'uimhir aici?
lines.en: Of course. Does she have your number?

lines.ga: Tá. Go raibh maith agat. Slán.
lines.en: Yes. Thank you. Bye.

lines.ga: Slán leat.
lines.en: Bye.

lines.ga: Cad a bheidh agat? Is ormsa an chéad bhabhta.
lines.en: What will you have? The first round is on me.

lines.ga: Go raibh maith agat. Beidh pionta Guinness agam.
lines.en: Thanks. I'll have a pint of Guinness.

lines.ga: Ar chuala tú go bhfuil seisiún ceoil ann anocht?
lines.en: Did you hear there's a music session on tonight?

lines.ga: Chuala. Sin an fáth ar tháinig mé, le fírinne.
lines.en: I did. That's why I came, to be honest.

lines.ga: An seinneann tú féin aon uirlis?
lines.en: Do you play an instrument yourself?

lines.ga: Seinnim an fheadóg stáin, ach ní sheinnim go rómhaith í.
lines.en: I play the tin whistle, but I don't play it very well.

lines.ga: Ba cheart duit í a thabhairt leat an chéad uair eile.
lines.en: You should bring it with you next time.

lines.ga: Dá mbeinn níos misniúla, thabharfainn.
lines.en: If I were braver, I would.

lines.ga: Ná bí cúthail! Sláinte!
lines.en: Don't be shy! Cheers!

lines.ga: Sláinte mhaith!
lines.en: Good health!

lines.ga: Cé a bhuafaidh, meas tú?
lines.en: Who'll win, do you reckon?

lines.ga: Gaillimh, gan amhras. Tá foireann iontach againn i mbliana.
lines.en: Galway, no doubt. We have a great team this year.

lines.ga: Ní aontaím leat. Bhuaigh Ciarraí orthu anuraidh.
lines.en: I don't agree. Kerry beat them last year.

lines.ga: Bhuaigh, ach bhí beirt imreoirí gortaithe againn an lá sin.
lines.en: They did, but we had two players injured that day.

lines.ga: Féach! Tá an liathróid sa líon!
lines.en: Look! The ball is in the net!

lines.ga: Cúl! Nach ndúirt mé leat é?
lines.en: A goal! Didn't I tell you?

lines.ga: Fan go fóill. Tá fiche nóiméad fágtha.
lines.en: Hold on. There are twenty minutes left.

lines.ga: Is cuma liom. Beimid ag ceiliúradh anocht.
lines.en: I don't care. We'll be celebrating tonight.

lines.ga: Fanfaimid go bhfeicfimid, a chara.
lines.en: We'll wait and see, my friend.
